headline: Growth accelerates, margins expand, guidance issued higher
summary_short: Datadog reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.12 billion, up 36% year-over-year, with non-GAAP operating margin of 23% (versus 20% a year ago) and free cash flow of $278.7 million. GAAP net income was $44.6 million and diluted EPS was $0.12.
summary_long: Revenue grew 36% y/y (+11% q/q) to $1.12B; $100k+ ARR customers rose 23% y/y to about 4,720. GAAP operating income was $5.5M (0% margin), versus a $35.5M loss a year ago; non-GAAP operating income was $257M (23% margin, up from 20%). GAAP diluted EPS was $0.12 vs $0.01 a year ago; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.65. Operating cash flow was $315.9M; free cash flow was $278.7M (25% margin). Cash, equivalents and marketable securities totaled $5.0B. Datadog guided Q3 2026 revenue to $1.135-1.145B, non-GAAP EPS to $0.63-0.65, and full-year 2026 revenue to $4.45-4.47B.

drivers.explanation: CEO attributes the quarter's performance to customers building and deploying AI workloads and using Datadog to observe, secure, and act on AI-enabled systems.
Growth is tied to expansion among larger accounts: customers with $100k+ ARR rose 23% y/y to about 4,720, from about 3,850 a year earlier.
Not explained in the release — no specific cost or margin driver is disclosed for the swing from an operating loss to a small operating profit.
